## File: intel_auto-round/auto_round_extension/mlx/qlinear_mlx.py

Prompts

```
['build a QuantLinearMLX module with 4-bit quantization and group size 128 for Apple Silicon inference', 'convert a GPTQ quantized linear module to MLX format using QuantLinearMLX.from_gptq for hardware accelerated inference', 'run a forward pass through a QuantLinearMLX layer that uses MLX quantized_matmul or falls back to PyTorch', 'unpack a uint32 packed weight tensor from a QuantLinearMLX layer back to integer values using _unpack_weight_torch', 'convert a PyTorch tensor to an MLX array using _torch_to_mlx with DLPack zero-copy transfer']
```
